name: Micro Finance Scheme
description: Concessional micro-credit for small income generation activities up to ₹1.40 Lakh.
targetAudience: Self-employed micro-entrepreneurs, small artisans, and street vendors.

name: Term Loan Scheme
description: Term loans for medium & large business units, transport, and commercial ventures up to ₹50.00 Lakh.
targetAudience: Small & medium enterprises, commercial vehicle operators, and service ventures.

name: Educational Loan Scheme
description: Concessional education loans for professional and technical courses in India or abroad.
targetAudience: Eligible SC students pursuing professional, medical, engineering, or higher technical degrees.
